title: ceratandra atrata
intro: Ceratandra atrata, commonly known as the Cape sundew, is a carnivorous plant species native to the Western Cape province of South Africa. The plant is known for its ability to obtain essential nutrients by capturing and digesting insects, making it an interesting subject for research. The health benefits of Ceratandra atrata are largely unexplored, but studies have shown that it may have therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
